items.title: Rate study
items.description: Discussion of the water rate study.
items.staff_report: Background: the consultant finished the cost-of-service study in November. Staff recommends that the Board adopt Resolution 2027-03 to increase the monthly base charge by 9 percent and authorize the General Manager to execute a $4,200,000 financing agreement. The increase would take effect March 1.

items.title: Well 7
items.description: Award a construction contract for the Well 7 rehabilitation project to Brightwater Pump Co. for $612,400.
items.staff_report: Staff recommends the Board award the Well 7 rehabilitation contract to Brightwater Pump Co. in the amount of $612,400.
